home.heroDescription: A 100% voice-controlled AI kitchen assistant. Turn videos into structured recipes, clone family voices, run parallel timers, and ask "what can I substitute for soy sauce?" — all without touching the screen.

voiceFirst.title: Voice-first everywhere
voiceFirst.body: Every tap has an equivalent voice command. Navigate, edit, search, set timers — all hands-free.

videoToRecipe.title: Video → recipe
videoToRecipe.body: Drop in any cooking video. ffmpeg.wasm + ElevenLabs STT structures it into ingredients & steps.

cloneVoice.title: Clone any voice
cloneVoice.body: At least 30 seconds of audio is enough to start cloning, while 1-2 minutes is more stable. Have Grandma narrate her dumpling recipe — forever.

parallelTimers.title: Parallel timers
parallelTimers.body: "Remind me to flip in 3 minutes and turn off heat at 8." Done — in one sentence.

aiSearch.title: AI recipe search
aiSearch.body: Local-first: searches your library before reaching the web. You own the knowledge base.

localData.title: 100% local data
localData.body: IndexedDB + AES-GCM encrypted keys. Your recipes never leave the device.

home.sixPillars: Six pillars. One promise — your hands stay where they belong.
home.sixPillarsBody: Every interaction in CookTalk has both a touch path and a voice path. The voice path is always primary.
home.phoneOnCounter: Phone on the counter. Hands in the dough.
home.phoneOnCounterBody: Below: a real flow — wake, navigate, cook, ask, time, finish. Zero touches.
home.configureOnce: Configure your ElevenLabs key once — by voice or by paste. Then never look back.

demo.narration: "Add the soy sauce and a tablespoon of rock sugar. Stir until the pork is glossy."
demo.question: "What can I use instead of dark soy sauce?"

1.ai: Showing 18 recipes. Say a number or a name.

2.you: Open the third one — red-braised pork.
2.ai: Got it. Tap or say 'start cooking'.

3.ai: Step 1: cut the pork belly into 2cm cubes.

4.you: Remind me to flip in 3 minutes and turn off heat at 8.
4.ai: Two timers set. I'll let you know.

5.you: What can I use instead of rock sugar?
5.ai: White sugar, halve the amount. Continue?

6.ai: Step 2: heat oil and brown the pork on all sides.

import.title: Turn any video or audio into a recipe.

import.manualTextImportTitle: Paste recipe text and let AI organize it
import.manualTextImportDescription: Paste rough notes, chat messages, or an unformatted text recipe. CookTalk will structure it and fill the standard form below, then you can review and save it yourself.
import.manualTextPlaceholder: For example: Tomato scrambled eggs. 2 tomatoes, 3 eggs. Cut tomatoes, beat eggs with salt. Scramble eggs first and set aside, cook tomatoes until juicy, add eggs back in and stir-fry for 2 minutes.
import.manualTextTooltip: Paste recipe text and organize it with AI

import.manualTextRequired: Please paste some recipe text first.

import.manualStepRequired: Please add at least one step.
import.manualSidebarHeading: A quick way to capture recipes
import.manualSidebarBody: Keep each step focused on one action, use minutes for timing, and separate flavor tags with commas.
import.manualSidebarStep1: Start with the title and a few key tags so it is easy to find later.
import.manualSidebarStep2: List ingredients as name plus amount. Empty rows are safe to leave out.
import.manualSidebarStep3: Write one action per step so cooking mode can read it clearly.
import.manualTextSidebarBody: If all you have is one rough block of recipe text, paste it first, let AI structure it, then review and fine-tune the fields.

voices.samplePrompt: Today we are making simple tomato eggs. First, cut two tomatoes into small pieces and beat the eggs with a little salt. Heat the pan, add oil, cook the eggs until they set, then take them out. Add the tomatoes, simmer until juicy, return the eggs, and stir everything together. Finish with scallions and serve with rice. This dish is bright, comforting, and easy to make for breakfast, lunch, or dinner.

voices.previewText: Hello, this is a CookTalk kitchen narration preview. Today we are making a simple everyday meal. First, rinse and chop the ingredients, then warm the pan and add a small amount of oil. When the aroma starts to rise, add the main ingredients and keep them moving over medium heat. Add the seasoning, taste for balance, and finish with fresh herbs before serving. Take it step by step, and the result will be calmer, warmer, and more consistent.
voices.previewPresetText: Hello, this is a CookTalk kitchen narration preview. Today we are making a simple everyday meal. First, rinse and chop the ingredients, then warm the pan and add a small amount of oil. When the aroma starts to rise, add the main ingredients and keep them moving over medium heat. Add the seasoning, taste for balance, and finish with fresh herbs before serving. Take it step by step, and the result will be calmer, warmer, and more consistent.
